def density_insertion(correlations,q,time,dual,block=None):
    """Same-q nonconjugating external density dual; actual source/target rho.

    This is ActiveBandCorrelations._transpose's existing density_dual, not
    an independent stochastic bath. h drops out of commutator's dh dual.
    """
    c=correlations.c
    block=c.q(q) if block is None else block
    _,zs,_=correlations._split(q,dual)
    rho,h=correlations._baseline(time)
    target=c.target[q]
    _,dh_dual=commutator_transpose(h[target],h,rho[target],rho,zs)
    feature=np.einsum('sabr,sabp->rp',block.potential,dh_dual,optimize=True)/correlations.root_n
    return block.kernel.T@feature


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CanonicalDensityFilter:
    force_filter: object
    density_segment_bounds: np.ndarray
    density_chebyshev: np.ndarray
    density_boundary_times: np.ndarray
    density_boundary: np.ndarray
    metadata: dict

    @property
    def arrays(self):
        return dict(**self.force_filter.arrays,density_segment_bounds=self.density_segment_bounds,
            density_chebyshev=self.density_chebyshev,density_boundary_times=self.density_boundary_times,
            density_boundary=self.density_boundary)

    def evaluate_density(self,time):
        time=float(time)
        if not np.isfinite(time) or not 0<=time<=self.force_filter.final_time:
            raise ValueError('density insertion time outside interval')
        right=int(np.searchsorted(self.density_boundary_times,time,side='left'))
        if right<len(self.density_boundary_times) and self.density_boundary_times[right]==time:
            return self.density_boundary[right].copy()
        left,end=self.density_segment_bounds[right-1]
        return np.polynomial.chebyshev.chebval(2*(time-left)/(end-left)-1,
                                              self.density_chebyshev[right-1])


class _DensityCapture:
    def __init__(self,correlations,q,baseline_knots):
        self.correlations,self.q=correlations,q
        self.block=correlations.c.q(q)
        self.baseline_knots=np.asarray(baseline_knots,float)
        self.nodes,self.transform=chebyshev_lobatto_transform(14)
        self.segments=[];self.boundaries={}

    def insertion(self,time,dual):
        value=density_insertion(self.correlations,self.q,time,dual,self.block)
        if not np.isfinite(value).all():raise FloatingPointError('nonfinite density dual')
        return value

    def boundary(self,time,dual):
        self.boundaries[float(time)]=self.insertion(time,dual)

    def segment(self,left,right,dense,shape):
        # No full-state history bank: the current public interpolant dies at
        # return. Split BEFORE multiplying represented degree7 rho and z.
        cuts=np.r_[left,self.baseline_knots[(self.baseline_knots>left)&(self.baseline_knots<right)],right]
        for a,b in zip(cuts[:-1],cuts[1:]):
            values=[]
            for j,node in enumerate(self.nodes):
                t=b if j==0 else a if j==14 else a+(b-a)*(node+1)/2
                values.append(self.insertion(t,dense(t).reshape(shape)))
            coefficients=np.tensordot(self.transform,np.asarray(values),axes=(1,0))
            self.segments.append((a,b,coefficients))
            self.boundaries[float(a)]=values[-1]
            self.boundaries.setdefault(float(b),values[0])


def build_canonical_density_filter(correlations,q,final_time,coordinates,*,baseline_knots=None):

    baseline_knots MUST cover the supplied degree<=7 baseline representation.
    For SavedMovingBaseline they default to its public .times. A non-polynomial
    arbitrary callable is unsupported, not silently sampled at degree7/14.
    On every union interval rho and z are degree7; fixed P/K and the commutator
    insertion are bilinear, hence degree<=14. Fifteen Lobatto samples recover
    that product without truncation or new tolerance/accuracy gate. Baseline
    and dual ODE approximation errors remain, not certified by this identity.

    knots=np.asarray(baseline_knots,float)
    if knots.ndim!=1 or len(knots)<2 or knots[0]!=0 or knots[-1]<final_time or np.any(np.diff(knots)<=0):
        raise ValueError('ascending baseline knots must cover [0,terminal]')

    force=build_canonical_force_filter(correlations,q,final_time,coordinates,capture=capture)
    segments=sorted(capture.segments,key=lambda row:row[0])

    r,p=capture.boundaries[times[0]].shape

        extra_interpolation_approximation=False,full_state_history_saved=False,
        error_scope='original ODE approximation errors retained; no new tolerance gate or enclosure')
    return CanonicalDensityFilter(force,bounds,coefficient,times,
        np.stack([capture.boundaries[t] for t in times]),metadata)

    out[:,:,5:,2]=density[:,:,:,0]
    for segment,(left,right) in enumerate(density_filter.density_segment_bounds):

def integrate_density_residual(saved, feature_provider, feature_indices, projector,
                               bounds, coefficients, *, target_saved=None, target_projector=None):
    """Cache only selected residual eigenvertices; never persist the mode bank.

    feature_provider(r)->(physical O_r, independently applied O_r†), already
    normalized by 1/sqrt(N). Exactly zero other-spin channels are not allocated.
    Each physical feature is projected ONCE, each interval/gap moment ONCE.
    Resident cache: 2*m*b*b*16 bytes; moments: 2*15*b*b*16; outputs:2*p*b*b*16.
    The caller's profile generator uses bounded PW-column batches.
    For nonzero q supply target_saved and target_projector from the actual
    k+q bank; vertices are [source_basis,target_basis], adjoints reversed.
    """
    coefficients = np.asarray(coefficients, complex)
    bounds = np.asarray(bounds, float)
    indices = tuple(int(i) for i in feature_indices)
    if coefficients.ndim != 4 or coefficients.shape[1] != 15:
        raise ValueError('density coefficients require [segment,15,feature,probe]')
    if bounds.shape != (len(coefficients), 2) or np.any(bounds[:, 1] <= bounds[:, 0]):
        raise ValueError('positive density intervals required')
    v, vi = saved['right_eigenvectors'], saved['inverse_right_eigenvectors']
    target_saved = saved if target_saved is None else target_saved
    target_projector = projector if target_projector is None else target_projector
    tv, tvi = target_saved['right_eigenvectors'], target_saved['inverse_right_eigenvectors']
    b, bt, probes = len(v), len(tv), coefficients.shape[-1]
    gaps = (saved['energy_gaps'] if target_saved is saved else
            saved['eigenvalues'][:, None] - target_saved['eigenvalues'][None, :])
    eigen = np.empty((len(indices), b, bt), complex)
    adj = np.empty((len(indices), bt, b), complex)
    defects = []
    for mode, feature in enumerate(indices):
        full, full_adjoint = feature_provider(feature)
        residual = full - projector @ full @ target_projector
        residual_adjoint = full_adjoint - target_projector @ full_adjoint @ projector
        eigen[mode] = vi @ residual @ tv
        adj[mode] = tv.conj().T @ residual_adjoint @ vi.conj().T
        defects.append(float(np.linalg.norm(full_adjoint - full.conj().T)))
    forward = np.zeros((probes, b, bt), complex)
    backward = np.zeros((probes, bt, b), complex)
    conversion = _chebyshev_to_legendre(15)
    if not np.array_equal(conversion[:8, :8], saved['chebyshev_to_legendre']):
        raise ValueError('higher-order conversion must preserve paid degree7 block')
    for segment, (left, right) in enumerate(bounds):
        half = (right-left)/2
        legendre = np.einsum('dk,kmp->dmp', conversion,
                             np.take(coefficients[segment], indices, axis=1))
        moments = _fourier_legendre_moments(gaps, half, left+half, 15)
        adjoint_moments = adjoint_moments_from_forward(moments)
        for mode in range(len(indices)):
            active = np.flatnonzero(np.any(legendre[:, mode] != 0, axis=0))
            for probe in active:
                forward[probe] += np.einsum('dij,d->ij', moments,
                    legendre[:, mode, probe]) * eigen[mode]
                backward[probe] += np.einsum('dij,d->ij', adjoint_moments,
                    legendre[:, mode, probe].conj()) * adj[mode]
    operators = v @ forward @ tvi
    adjoints = tvi.conj().T @ backward @ v.conj().T
    return dict(operators=operators, adjoint_operators=adjoints,
        diagnostics=dict(all_outputs_finite=bool(np.isfinite(operators).all()
            and np.isfinite(adjoints).all()), moment_evaluations=len(bounds),
            physical_features=len(indices), supplied_adjoint_defects=defects,
            resident_eigenvertex_bytes=int(eigen.nbytes+adj.nbytes), eigensolves=0),
        matching='integral density_dual_r(t)*(O_full_r(t)-P O_full_r(t) P); retained physical vertex propagated by SAME paid H')

import numpy as np


def compose_same_source(preparation, preparation_adjoint, ionic_residual,
                        ionic_adjoint, field_residual, field_adjoint,
                        density_residual, density_adjoint):
    matrices = dict(preparation=preparation, ionic=ionic_residual,
                    field=field_residual, density=density_residual)
    adjoints = dict(preparation=preparation_adjoint, ionic=ionic_adjoint,
                    field=field_adjoint, density=density_adjoint)
    matrices['matched'] = sum(matrices.values())
    adjoints['matched'] = sum(adjoints.values())
    if not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (*matrices.values(), *adjoints.values())):
        raise ValueError('nonfinite same-source operator')
    return matrices, adjoints


def substitution_readout(moments, original_ordered, represented_ordered):

    The original total must be from the SAME backward dual, baseline, terminal
    probe and state used to embed preparation. It is not an A32 hybrid total.
    All16 ordered cross terms of the four component operators are retained.
    represented_ordered is the actual source0 active Wick term in that total,
    not an inferred P O P variance. Its full-frame CAR compression defect is
    reported separately; numerical state defects are not silently equated.
    """

    parts = ('preparation', 'ionic', 'field', 'density')
    required = {(a, b) for a in (*parts, 'matched') for b in (*parts, 'matched')}
    if set(values) != required:
        raise ValueError('complete25 ordered same-source pairs required')
    old = represented_ordered
    new = values['matched', 'matched']

        same_source_substitution=new-old,
        conditional_matched_active_total=original_ordered-old+new,
        raw_preparation_compression_difference=values['preparation', 'preparation']-old,

class BorrowedBathFrame:
    """B=[psi S^-1/2,E] without storing/rebuilding B; paid E and S borrowed."""
    def __init__(self, psi, inverse_sqrt_gram, extra_basis):
        self.psi, self.inverse, self.extra = psi, inverse_sqrt_gram, extra_basis
        self.rank = psi.shape[1]
        self.size = self.rank + extra_basis.shape[1]
        if inverse_sqrt_gram.shape != (self.rank, self.rank) or extra_basis.shape[0] != len(psi):
            raise ValueError('paid frame coordinate shapes differ')

    def columns(self, start, stop):
        if stop <= self.rank:
            return self.psi @ self.inverse[:, start:stop]
        if start >= self.rank:
            return self.extra[:, start-self.rank:stop-self.rank]
        return np.concatenate((self.psi @ self.inverse[:, start:self.rank],
                               self.extra[:, :stop-self.rank]), axis=1)

    def left_project(self, action):
        return np.concatenate((self.inverse.conj().T @ (self.psi.conj().T @ action),
                               self.extra.conj().T @ action), axis=0)


def project_density_feature(bridge, source_frame, target_frame, g, *, ncells,
                            block_size=8):
    """Return O_st/sqrt(N), O_ts†/sqrt(N), independently applied.

    Works for every actual directed q bridge; source/target can have distinct
    PW and finite-bath dimensions. Caller selects the explicit spin feature.
    No quadrature weight, spin multiplier or final inverse Fourier 1/N occurs.
    One PW column block and two projected matrices live at a time.
    """
    if type(ncells) is not int or ncells < 1 or block_size < 1:
        raise ValueError('positive exact N and column block size required')
    if hasattr(bridge, 'potential_action'):
        # Existing physical q=0 dyad coupling is a multiplication action.
        fft = bridge.factors.fft
        field = profile(fft.physical, g, fft.omega)
        apply_density = lambda vectors: bridge.potential_action(field.conj(), vectors)
        apply_adjoint = lambda vectors: bridge.potential_action(field, vectors)
    else:
        fft = bridge.source_fft if hasattr(bridge, 'source_fft') else bridge.orbital_fft
        field = profile(fft.physical, g, fft.omega)
        apply_density = lambda vectors: bridge.local_adjoint_apply(field, vectors)
        apply_adjoint = lambda vectors: bridge.local_apply(field, vectors)
    forward = np.empty((source_frame.size, target_frame.size), complex)
    adjoint = np.empty((target_frame.size, source_frame.size), complex)
    for start in range(0, target_frame.size, block_size):
        stop = min(start + block_size, target_frame.size)
        forward[:, start:stop] = source_frame.left_project(
            apply_density(target_frame.columns(start, stop)))
    for start in range(0, source_frame.size, block_size):
        stop = min(start + block_size, source_frame.size)
        adjoint[:, start:stop] = target_frame.left_project(
            apply_adjoint(source_frame.columns(start, stop)))
    forward /= np.sqrt(ncells)
    adjoint /= np.sqrt(ncells)
    return forward, adjoint

pairing. A physical ionic force is added to p-prime, and a field-momentum
force to Pi-prime, both with plus sign. Thus their kernels are exactly the
p and Pi entries of z(tau) propagated with z'=-L(tau).T z backwards.

Only these small forcing entries of each accepted DOP853 dense interpolant
are retained. The full dual survives ONLY at preparation time zero, for
later preparation/source cross terms. This is not passive noise or loss.

_DEGREE = 7
# Installed SciPy rk.py:Dop853DenseOutput evaluates seven nested factors
# (dop853_coefficients.INTERPOLATOR_POWER=7): a degree <=7 polynomial.
# Eight Lobatto samples therefore change representation, not the physical
# approximation or its adaptive error tolerance. No private solver data used.
def chebyshev_lobatto_transform(degree):
    """Degree-preserving transform from descending Chebyshev Lobatto nodes."""
    nodes = np.cos(np.pi * np.arange(degree + 1) / degree)
    transform = (2.0 / degree) * np.cos(
        np.pi * np.outer(np.arange(degree + 1), np.arange(degree + 1)) / degree)
    transform[:, [0, -1]] *= 0.5
    transform[[0, -1], :] *= 0.5
    return nodes, transform


_NODES, _TRANSFORM = chebyshev_lobatto_transform(_DEGREE)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CanonicalForceFilter:
    """Small, ascending-time piecewise-Chebyshev force kernels.

    segment_bounds[s] = [left,right], and local x=(2*t-left-right)/(right-left).
    ionic_chebyshev[s,k,i,p] multiplies T_k(x) for ionic force coordinate i
    and terminal probe p; field_chebyshev has the same layout with field i.
    boundary_times and *_boundary contain every actual accepted endpoint,
    including zero and final_time. Exact-knot evaluation uses those values;
    interior evaluation uses the polynomial on that interval. Empty field
    axes for q != 0 are intentional: global field modes belong only to Gamma.
    """

    final_time: float
    initial_dual: np.ndarray
    segment_bounds: np.ndarray
    ionic_chebyshev: np.ndarray
    field_chebyshev: np.ndarray
    boundary_times: np.ndarray
    ionic_boundary: np.ndarray
    field_boundary: np.ndarray
    metadata: dict

    @property
    def arrays(self):
        """Numeric-only, NPZ-ready persistence payload (metadata is separate JSON)."""
        return {
            'initial_dual': self.initial_dual,
            'segment_bounds': self.segment_bounds,
            'ionic_chebyshev': self.ionic_chebyshev,
            'field_chebyshev': self.field_chebyshev,
            'boundary_times': self.boundary_times,
            'ionic_boundary': self.ionic_boundary,
            'field_boundary': self.field_boundary,
        }

    def evaluate(self, time):
        """Return (ionic_force[ndof,nprobes], field_force[nfield,nprobes]).

        These are response coefficients, not realizations of a stochastic
        force. No extrapolation, conjugation, mass or cell normalization.
        """
        if np.ndim(time) != 0:
            raise ValueError('one scalar force-insertion time required')
        time = float(time)
        if not np.isfinite(time) or not 0.0 <= time <= self.final_time:
            raise ValueError('force-insertion time must lie in [0, final_time]')
        right = int(np.searchsorted(self.boundary_times, time, side='left'))
        if right < len(self.boundary_times) and self.boundary_times[right] == time:
            return self.ionic_boundary[right].copy(), self.field_boundary[right].copy()
        segment = right - 1
        left_time, right_time = self.segment_bounds[segment]
        x = 2.0 * ((time - left_time) / (right_time - left_time)) - 1.0
        return (np.polynomial.chebyshev.chebval(x, self.ionic_chebyshev[segment]),
                np.polynomial.chebyshev.chebval(x, self.field_chebyshev[segment]))

    __call__ = evaluate


def build_canonical_force_filter(correlations, q, final_time, coordinates, *, capture=None):
    """Integrate the existing moving L_q(t).T using its original rtol/atol.

    The one q coefficient block is held just as in backward_linear_probes.
    DOP853.step(), .t_old/.t and .dense_output() are public SciPy interfaces;
    no OdeSolution/full-state history or transition matrix is retained.
    ``capture`` optionally receives ephemeral duals through boundary(time, dual)
    and segment(left, right, dense, shape). It must retain only its small
    physical insertions, never the full-state arrays. Existing force consumers
    need no callback and retain their unchanged array/evaluation contract.
    """
    if np.ndim(final_time) != 0:
        raise ValueError('scalar terminal time in inverse Ry required')
    final_time = float(final_time)
    if not np.isfinite(final_time) or final_time < 0.0:
        raise ValueError('finite nonnegative terminal time in inverse Ry required')
    if not isinstance(q, (int, np.integer)):
        raise ValueError('integer q index required')
    q = int(q)
    if not 0 <= q < correlations.c.nq:
        raise ValueError('q index outside coefficient mesh')
    coordinates = tuple(coordinates)
    terminal = correlations.ionic_probes(q, coordinates)
    shape = terminal.shape
    d = int(correlations.c.d)
    f = int(correlations.c.f) if q == 0 else 0
    p = slice(d, 2*d)
    pi = slice(2*d + f, 2*d + 2*f)

    def force_entries(value):
        dual = value.reshape(shape)
        return dual[p].copy(), dual[pi].copy()

    bounds, ionic_segments, field_segments = [], [], []
    boundary_times = [final_time]
    ionic_end, field_end = force_entries(terminal)
    ionic_boundary, field_boundary = [ionic_end], [field_end]
    if capture is not None:
        capture.boundary(final_time, terminal)
    nfev = 0
    first_step = None
    if final_time == 0.0:
        initial_dual = terminal.copy()
    else:
        block = correlations.c.q(q)

        def rhs(time, value):
            return -correlations._transpose(q, time, value.reshape(shape), block).ravel()

        interval = (final_time, 0.0)
        first_step = bounded_first_step(rhs, interval, terminal.ravel(),
                                        rtol=correlations.rtol, atol=correlations.atol)
        solver = DOP853(rhs, final_time, terminal.ravel(), 0.0,
                        rtol=correlations.rtol, atol=correlations.atol,
                        first_step=first_step)
        # terminal is no longer needed; DOP853 owns its initial state reference.
        while solver.status == 'running':
            message = solver.step()
            if solver.status == 'failed':
                raise RuntimeError(f'backward canonical force filter solve failed: {message}')
            left, right = float(solver.t), float(solver.t_old)
            if not left < right:
                raise RuntimeError('backward DOP853 accepted a nondecreasing interval')
            dense = solver.dense_output()
            ionic_samples = np.empty((_DEGREE+1, d, shape[1]), complex)
            field_samples = np.empty((_DEGREE+1, f, shape[1]), complex)
            for j, node in enumerate(_NODES):
                # Explicit endpoints avoid roundoff excursions outside a bounded
                # baseline. Dense evaluation itself never calls the baseline.
                time = right if j == 0 else left if j == _DEGREE else (
                    left + (right-left)*(node+1.0)/2.0)
                value = dense(time)
                ionic_samples[j], field_samples[j] = force_entries(value)
            ionic_coeff = np.tensordot(_TRANSFORM, ionic_samples, axes=(1, 0))
            field_coeff = np.tensordot(_TRANSFORM, field_samples, axes=(1, 0))
            if not (np.all(np.isfinite(ionic_coeff)) and np.all(np.isfinite(field_coeff))):
                raise FloatingPointError('nonfinite force polynomial; no clipping applied')
            bounds.append((left, right))
            ionic_segments.append(ionic_coeff)
            field_segments.append(field_coeff)
            boundary_times.append(left)
            ionic_end, field_end = force_entries(solver.y)
            ionic_boundary.append(ionic_end)
            field_boundary.append(field_end)
            if capture is not None:
                capture.segment(left, right, dense, shape)
                capture.boundary(left, solver.y.reshape(shape))
            # Do not retain a full-state interpolant between accepted steps.
            del dense, value
        initial_dual = solver.y.reshape(shape).copy()
        nfev = int(solver.nfev)
        del solver
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(initial_dual)):
        raise FloatingPointError('nonfinite initial dual; no clipping applied')
    count = len(bounds)
    segment_bounds = np.asarray(bounds[::-1], dtype=float).reshape(count, 2)
    ionic_chebyshev = (np.stack(ionic_segments[::-1]) if count else
                       np.empty((0, _DEGREE+1, d, shape[1]), complex))
    field_chebyshev = (np.stack(field_segments[::-1]) if count else
                       np.empty((0, _DEGREE+1, f, shape[1]), complex))
    metadata = {
        'schema': 'P254-canonical-force-filter-v1',
        'q_index': q,
        'coordinates': [int(i) for i in coordinates],
        'final_time_inverse_ry': final_time,
        'state_size': int(shape[0]),
        'ndof': d,
        'nfield': f,
        'nprobes': int(shape[1]),
        'method': 'DOP853',
        'rtol': np.asarray(correlations.rtol).tolist(),
        'atol': np.asarray(correlations.atol).tolist(),
        'first_step': first_step,
        'nfev': nfev,
        'accepted_intervals': count,
        'polynomial_degree': _DEGREE,
        'polynomial_basis': 'Chebyshev T_k, k=0..7; x=2*(t-left)/(right-left)-1',
        'polynomial_origin': 'eight public DOP853 dense-evaluator Lobatto samples per accepted interval',
        'approximation': 'representation of existing degree-seven DOP853 interpolant, not a new tolerance gate',
        'interval_order': 'ascending physical time, each row [left,right]',
        'boundary_policy': 'exact stored accepted-state values at every knot, including time zero and terminal time',
        'array_axes': {
            'initial_dual': ['state', 'probe'],
            'segment_bounds': ['segment', 'left_right'],
            'ionic_chebyshev': ['segment', 'degree', 'ionic_force', 'probe'],
            'field_chebyshev': ['segment', 'degree', 'field_momentum_force', 'probe'],
            'boundary_times': ['boundary'],
            'ionic_boundary': ['boundary', 'ionic_force', 'probe'],
            'field_boundary': ['boundary', 'field_momentum_force', 'probe'],
        },
        'state_layout': '[u(d), p(d), A(f), Pi(f), sigma(ns,m,m).ravel()] at Gamma; [u,p,sigma] otherwise',
        'ionic_force_state_slice': [d, 2*d],
        'field_force_state_slice': [2*d+f, 2*d+2*f],
        'pairing': 'nonconjugating z.T @ state; same q, no -q swap',
        'force_insertion': 'plus ionic force into p-prime, plus field-momentum force into Pi-prime',
        'extra_mass_weight_cell_factors': False,
        'history': 'only small canonical-force polynomials and boundaries; full dual only at preparation zero',
        'scope': 'conditional moving active-model causal output filter; not full passive noise, physical loss or lifetime',
    }
    return CanonicalForceFilter(
        final_time, initial_dual, segment_bounds, ionic_chebyshev, field_chebyshev,
        np.asarray(boundary_times[::-1], dtype=float),
        np.stack(ionic_boundary[::-1]), np.stack(field_boundary[::-1]), metadata,
    )
